title: End action for a register
statement: For a register index $r$ among $m$ work tapes and a state $d_B$, let the action write the blank symbol on tape $r$, move its head one cell to the left, and enter state $d_B$, leaving the other action components as specified by the register-action construction.
hypotheses_covered: $r$ is an index among the $m$ work tapes
caveat: The referenced register-action construction is not included among the supplied definitions, so the remaining action components cannot be stated precisely.
